title: Kodiak Ultra Marathons — 2027 calendar entry
claims: UltraRunning's calendar lists the 2027 Kodiak 100-mile on 8 October 2027 with a 36-hour cut-off and the 100K on 9 October 2027 with a 20-hour cut-off.
The same calendar's past-results table lists 2026 100M 279 finishers with 20:43:40 and 16:46:21 as the top women's and men's times.
The calendar's past-results table gives the 2023 100M winners as 21:10:28 and 16:22:08.

verification.note: 2026-11-20 直读 UltraRunning 日历页；2027 日期为第三方日历，不是组委会确认，正文明确标为参考。
